# Pete Ryan

> Pete Ryan works on Growth at Supabase, the Postgres development platform. He is a two-time venture-backed founder based in Austin, Texas: co-founder and CEO of HiFive (raised $5.5M, acquired by HeyLois in November 2025) and co-founder of Gogohire. He led enterprise sales at Trello (2016-17) through its $425M acquisition by Atlassian, and was one of LinkedIn's first sales hires, where he started LinkedIn Sales Solutions and landed its first 100 logos. University of Dayton graduate.

Not to be confused with other people named Peter or Pete Ryan (e.g., Australian journalists or politicians, a Dallas real-estate agent, or a Chicago Salesforce consultancy CEO).
